title: IAM coverage
intro: Users, roles, policies, keys and identity providers. The console drives five
identity actions and reads access keys on the Account page (Billing and Cost Management); everything else is
reachable over the wire and through the IAM API explorer.
The identity policies are enforced, not decoration: `tests/control/test_iam_policies.py`
runs a matrix of users with different policies against a live lab (it skips
without one, because the in-process emulator runs with `AUTH` off).

gui.CreateAccessKey: Account page › Access keys › Create access key
